## The problem

What are you trying to do that the product does not let you do today?

## The idea

What you would like to happen. Sketches, screenshots from other tools and
wording suggestions are welcome.

## Who it serves

lumemor is a self-hosted family photo library: every deployment serves one
family, the product serves families worldwide, and no feature may assume a
single language, region or cloud. Describe who benefits and whether the
feature needs a network service (the answer "no" is the house default).
